description: Once-a-day gate for the CI nightly (owner decision, 26 Nov 2026): ci-nightly.yml wakes after each push CI run on main and on its fallback cron, and dispatches ci.yml on main with nightly: true only when no wake has today (the ci-nightly-<date> marker artifact or a CI nightly run already exists) and only from 02:00 UTC. Also exports isNightlyRun and nightlyRuns, which every nightly-only consumer uses to recognise the dispatched nightly (titled CI nightly) and the scheduled ones from before. Reads the Actions API and writes dispatch, day, marker and reason to GITHUB_OUTPUT.
